Job Description: Data Analyst Trainer



 



Company: GamakaAI 



 



Position: Data Analyst Trainer



 



Experience: 0–5 Years



 



Employment Type: Full-Time



 



Location: Pune , FC Road



 



About GamakaAI 



GamakaAI Institute is focused on building industry-ready talent through practical, hands-on training in emerging technologies and professional skills. We are looking for a passionate Data Analyst Trainer who can train students from beginner to job-ready level and help them develop the technical and professional skills required to succeed in data analytics careers.



 



Role Overview



As a Data Analyst Trainer, you will be responsible for delivering engaging, practical, and industry-oriented training to students and fresh graduates. The trainer should be able to explain technical concepts from scratch, conduct hands-on exercises, guide students through real-world projects, and prepare them for data analyst interviews.



 



Key Responsibilities



Conduct classroom/online training sessions on Data Analytics.



Teach students from basic to advanced levels.



Explain concepts using practical examples, case studies, and real-world datasets.



Create and deliver training content, presentations, assignments, quizzes, and assessments.



Provide hands-on training and practical exercises.



Guide students in building Data Analytics projects and portfolios.



Conduct mock interviews and technical assessments.



Prepare students for Data Analyst job interviews.



Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.



Help students understand industry expectations and workplace data-analysis practices.



Stay updated with current data analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends.



Collaborate with the academic/training team to improve course content and student outcomes.



 



Technical Skills Required



1. Advanced Excel



Data cleaning and data formatting



Pivot Tables & Pivot Charts



XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP



INDEX-MATCH



IF, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and other advanced formulas



Conditional Formatting



Data Validation



Charts and dashboards



Power Query



Basic Excel automation/macros is an advantage



2. SQL



SQL fundamentals



SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY



Aggregate functions



JOINS



Subqueries



CTEs



CASE statements



Window functions



Data filtering and transformation



Query optimization basics



 



3. Python for Data Analytics



Python fundamentals



NumPy



Pandas



Data cleaning and preprocessing



Data manipulation



Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)



Data visualization



Matplotlib / Seaborn



Working with CSV and Excel files



Basic statistical analysis



4. Microsoft Power BI



Power BI Desktop



Data import and transformation



Power Query



Data cleaning



Data modeling



Relationships



DAX fundamentals and advanced DAX



Calculated columns and measures



KPIs



Interactive dashboards and reports



Power BI visualizations



Publishing and sharing reports



 



2 Basic understanding of Power BI Service



Good to Have



Knowledge of statistics for data analysis



Experience with real-world analytics projects



Knowledge of Tableau or other BI tools



Understanding of data visualization principles



Experience in creating dashboards and business reports



Familiarity with Git/GitHub



Previous teaching, mentoring, or corporate training experience



 



Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who:



Has strong communication and presentation skills.



Can explain technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner.



Is comfortable teaching students with little or no prior technical knowledge.



Has a practical, hands-on approach to teaching.



Can motivate and mentor students.



Is comfortable conducting mock interviews and assessments.



Has a passion for teaching and helping students build careers in Data Analytics.



Can handle classroom discussions and student queries effectively.



 



Eligibility



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics,



Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field.



Experience: 0–5 years



Freshers with strong knowledge of Data Analytics and excellent communication skills are welcome to apply.



Candidates with previous training/teaching experience will be an advantage.



 



What You Will Do at GamakaAI Institute



You will not only teach tools—you will help students become job-ready Data Analysts.



The role involves taking students through the complete journey:



Excel → SQL → Python → Power BI → Data Analysis → Projects → Resume Preparation → Mock



Interviews → Job Readiness



 



Key Skills



Advanced Excel | SQL | Python | Pandas | NumPy | Data Analytics | Power BI | Power Query | DAX |



Data Visualization | Data Cleaning | Data Modeling | Dashboard Development | Communication



Skills | Training & Mentoring

Job Summary   

The Chance: The Marketing Data Analyst is responsible for delivering data-driven insights that improve marketing performance and support business growth to the BMP segment. Working closely with marketing stakeholders, this role translates marketing strategy, funnel objectives, and business requirements into reporting, dashboards, and analytical capabilities that enable data-driven decision-making. Experience within a life sciences, healthcare, scientific, or other B2B environment is preferred.  

Required Capabilities/competencies   
Experience in marketing analytics, attribution modelling, funnel analysis, and campaign performance measurement.  
Partner with marketing stakeholders to understand objectives and define reporting and measurement needs.  
Translate business requirements into actionable dashboards, KPIs, and insights.  
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions.  
Analyse data from CRM, marketing automation, web, social, and advertising platforms.  
Provide recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness, customer engagement, and ROI.  
Support testing and optimisation initiatives, including A/B testing and audience segmentation.  
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers.  
Build scalable reporting frameworks and measurement standards.  
Communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.  
Stay current on marketing analytics best practices and emerging technologies.  
Support a data-driven marketing culture through stakeholder enablement and actionable insights.  

JOB Requirements   
Bachelors degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Economics  
Experience in life sciences, healthcare, scientific, or B2B environments preferred.  
Understanding of marketing principles and funnel metrics  
Experience in using Microsoft Excel, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Power BI  
Experience with marketing analytics tools and techniques, including web analytics, social media analytics, marketing automation, and CRM tools  
Proven ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights  
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills  
Excellent communication and presentation skills  
Able to work independently as well as part of a team  
Experience working with remote and global teammates  
Comfortable navigating and influencing in a highly matrixed workplace  
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills  
Demonstrate robust desire to learn and grow .

Contact Sharifunnisa Mohammed
